item_short_desc: Rothco's Hard Shell Shin Guards have been designed to protect the knee, shin, ankle and foot. The plates are made of non-reflective polycarbonate and are padded with a durable mesh covered EVA foam cushion and innerpolyester tricot lining. In addition the hard shell shin guards feature padded outer ankle protectors and adjustable/removable foot plates with three hook & loop closures on the backside for a perfect customized fit. The shin guards also come with a nylon gear bag for easy carry.
